schema.description: The Luma Agents generation request object

example.prompt: a red circle on a plain white background

image_ref.description: Reference images for style/content guidance. Up to 9 for type 'image', up to 8 for type 'image_edit'.

model.description: Model to use. uni-1 / uni-1-max for image generation, ray-3.2 for video generation, editing, and reframing.

LumaAgentsAspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio. The ray-3.2 video models support the subset 9:16, 3:4, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 21:9.

LumaAgentsGenerationType.description: The kind of generation to perform. image/image_edit are produced by the uni-1 / uni-1-max models; video/video_edit/video_reframe are produced by the ray-3.2 model.

LumaAgentsImageRef.description: Reference to an image or video. Used for style/content guidance, guided generation, video-edit/video-reframe sources, and guide keyframes. Provide exactly one of generation_id, url, or data.

generation_id.description: UUID of a prior completed generation to reuse as the source. Used by ray-3.2 video_edit / video_reframe.

media_type.description: MIME type. Required with data (and with url for video sources, e.g. video/mp4 on video_edit / video_reframe).

url.description: Publicly accessible image or video URL

LumaAgentsVideoDuration.description: Clip duration for ray-3.2 video / video_edit. Defaults to 5s. HDR generation (type video) is restricted to 5s.

LumaAgentsVideoOptions.description: Video output settings for ray-3.2. Only the fields that affect validation and billing are modelled here; additional fields (edit controls, end_frame, loop, source_position) are forwarded to Luma untouched.

exr_export.description: Export an EXR file alongside the MP4. Requires hdr true. Rejected for video_reframe.

hdr.description: Render in HDR. Requires 720p/1080p. Rejected for video_reframe.

keyframes.description: Guide-frame images. A single keyframe makes a type "video" request a single-keyframe extend, which always bills as one 5s block.

loop.description: Loop the generated clip. Create-only (type video).

LumaAgentsVideoResolution.description: Output resolution for ray-3.2 video. Defaults to 720p. 360p is the draft tier. HDR requires 720p or 1080p.
